_note: Every image the site uses, by id. Components never reference /public paths directly. clinic-* and doctor-* are the clinic's OWN photos (approved, no credit; supplied by the account owner 25–26 Oct 2026; doctor-* are two crops of images/dr-aishwarya.png that leave out its printed name label, max 680 px wide, so they are shown at card/gallery sizes and the hero uses a cropped one under an overlay). Every other photo is a REPRESENTATIVE stock image (Unsplash / Pexels licences, content/photo-credits.json, field credit) showing Indian faces. The logo is the clinic's own (images/logo.png, transparent version supplied 25 Oct 2026).

source._note: Clinic logo master: silver tooth with a graphite 'A' and an implant screw. npm run brand builds the header mark, favicon, app icons and OG image from it; the same PNG is uploaded as the ClinicFlow white-label logo + favicon.
